title: Zahi Hawass pumps out the Osiris shaft and opens the container
summary: Jeffrey tells of Zahi Hawass pumps out the Osiris shaft and opens the container, about unspecified excavation at Egypt (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: time? Oh, I don't know, but so this was done by Zahi Hawass and team. They pumped all the water out so that they could lift the lid off of the container on the third level.

plain: A podcast guest named Jeffrey says that a team led by Zahi Hawass, a well-known Egyptian archaeologist, pumped all the water out of the Osiris shaft, a deep flooded shaft at Giza in Egypt. According to Jeffrey, they did this so they could lift the lid off a large stone container on the shaft's third level. He tells it as part of a claim that something like a huge energy system lies beneath the pyramids.
